Wisdom Teeth Removal

A 1-minute patient guide with narration. Press space to pause.

Patient guide

Wisdom teeth.

What to expect when they need to come out.

The last to arrive.

Wisdom teeth are the third molars, at the very back. They usually come in between 17 and 25.

Not enough room.

They often come in tilted or stay trapped under the gums.

A closer look.

X-rays show exactly how your wisdom teeth are positioned.

Comfortable care.

We numb the area, and sedation may be an option to help you relax.

Gently removed.

The tooth is carefully removed, sometimes in sections. A few stitches may be placed.

The first few days.

Be gentle with the area while it heals.

Bite on gauzeIce for swellingSoft foodsNo straws or smoking

Healing well.

Most people feel better within a few days. We'll make sure you're healing well.

Questions? Just ask.

Your dental team is happy to walk you through every step.
